description: This file handles AJAX requests for setting IP configuration, including DHCP and IPv6 settings, performs validation, and updates device settings via setStr calls.
published: Validation functions for IP and GW addresses

methods.name: isValidIP
methods.description: Validates if an IP address falls within a specified range.

methods.name: ipRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end of an IP range based on gateway address and subnet mask.

methods.name: valid_GW_IP
methods.description: Checks if a gateway IP is within a specified range.

methods.name: isValidGW
methods.description: Validates a GW IP address along with subnet mask and address range, ensuring adherence to RFC1918 private IP ranges.
